newsitem.title: USA: BOLDER Technologies Q1 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: BOLDER Technologies Q1 net loss widens.

text.p: NOTE: The company said that to enhance comparability between periods, the loss from its joint venture of $88,779 in the first quarter of 1996 has been reclassified into research and development expense. This reclassification reflects the termination of the joint venture with Johnson Controls Inc in 1996, in connection with the restructured strategic partnership.

Bolder Technologies Corp said its revenue for the first quarter of 1997 included the company's recognition of approximately $442,000 in research and development services revenues in connection with the technology transfer arrangement with Johnson Controls. The company also said that it recognized smaller amounts of research and development revenue from a government funded technology development program.
The company was not available to discuss its comparable earnings per share or average shares outstanding for the first quarter of 1996.
